name: Jackie Pro

movements.notes: must be completed within 3:15 (men) / 3:40 (women) to continue

origin.summary: An event from the 2022 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: A row, thruster, and bar-muscle-up chipper with a strict time standard on the row — a harder, bar-muscle-up version of the classic Girl WOD Jackie.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2022/13 (official CrossFit Games event), retrieved 2026-07-09; a heavier-loaded, bar-muscle-up variant of the Girl WOD Jackie, with a qualifying row-time standard to continue to the thrusters/muscle-ups
